sourceFile: 3. BRS-161014 Report check problem Sub 2 K3 2023.08.03_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it merges many unrelated DOE and repair comparisons into one malformed changed-factor case.
issues: Primary changed factor is over-aggregated across unrelated tests and sheets.
Baseline and test conditions mix material, repair, bonding, temperature, supplier, and process settings.
Several outcomes are unjudged or use invalid metrics such as section headers and bogus specs.
Subgroup key is meaningless and row grouping keys are not preserved.
Some cited rows are absent from provided context or lack supporting header/data linkage.
correctionPlan: Split cases by coherent validation context and primary changed factor.
Define clear baseline and test conditions per date, sheet, test, supplier, SM type, and process setting.
Remove generic measurement candidates, header-derived metrics, and invalid >80 specs.
Recompute visual NG and tension outcomes only from valid paired rows.
Cite header, condition, result, and decision rows for each corrected comparison.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are insufficient; citeable rows exist, but grouping and row support must be rebuilt.
